morphology.pattern_note: 不作词缀拆分。马来西亚马来语常将词尾 k 实现为声门塞音 /ʔ/。以下词族项目为复合搭配，不是另造的派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 用丝绸等布料制成、系在腰间的腰带或束腰带。
senses.en_definition: A cloth belt or waist sash, made from silk or another fabric.
senses.ms_definition: Ikat pinggang yang dibuat daripada kain, seperti sutera; bengkung.
senses.nuances: 本词条以输入包所载的布制腰带义为核心。在马来西亚日常语境，普通裤带更常称 tali pinggang；车辆安全带通常称 tali pinggang keledar。参见 [PRPM：sabuk](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=sabuk)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pameran tekstil itu mengetengahkan sabuk sutera sebagai salah satu aksesori pakaian tradisional.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该纺织品展览把丝绸腰带作为传统服饰配件之一加以展示。
dual_scenarios.en: The textile exhibition features silk sashes among its traditional clothing accessories.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Sabuk ni ikat kat pinggang je, kan?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Sabuk ini hanya perlu diikat pada pinggang, betul?
dual_scenarios.zh: 这条腰带系在腰上就行了，对吧？
dual_scenarios.en: You just tie this sash around your waist, right?
spoken_features: 口语省略了标准被动结构中的 perlu diikat

messages.speaker: Mei (舞蹈班同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Sabuk ni ikat kat pinggang je, kan?
messages.ms_standard: Sabuk ini hanya perlu diikat pada pinggang, betul?
messages.zh: 这条腰带系在腰上就行了，对吧？
messages.en: You just tie this sash around your waist, right?

messages.speaker: Aina (舞蹈班同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Haah, tapi jangan ketat sangat. Nak menari nanti susah.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, tetapi jangan mengikatnya terlalu ketat kerana nanti sukar untuk menari.
messages.zh: 对，不过别系太紧，不然等下跳舞不方便。
messages.en: Yes, but don't tie it too tightly, or it'll be hard to dance.

etymology.historical_story: Sabuk evokes a clothing tradition in which fabric is wrapped and secured around the waist. Kamus Dewan illustrates it through a literary passage involving Tun Menida, placing the object within Malay storytelling. Javanese also records sabuk, but that parallel alone cannot establish a borrowing direction or date. Remember the shared object without inventing a migration story. [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=sabuk), [KBJI](https://kbji.kemendikdasmen.go.id/kata/sabuk).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sa-buk：想象一条布带绕腰收紧，词尾 /ʔ/ 轻轻一收，腰带也稳稳束住。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 讨论服饰时用语中性。帮助别人系腰带前，应先征得同意；可说 Boleh saya bantu ikatkan sabuk ini?，避免直接触碰对方腰部。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合传统服饰、舞蹈、纺织品和文学语境。向穿戴者了解绑法与场合要求，不应把所有传统腰带都当作可随意互换的装饰。
